summaries.title: Large Language Models as Optimizers
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Optimization** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Optimization by
PROmpting (OPRO) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this work, we propose Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO), a simple and effective approach to leverage large language models (LLMs) as optimizers, where the optimization task...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **GSM8K**。实验设计与验证细节：While derivative-based algorithms have been powerful tools for various problems, the absence of gradient imposes challenges on many real-world applications。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **8%, 50%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We first showcase OPRO on linear regression and traveling salesman problems, then move on to prompt optimization...；With a variety of LLMs, we demonstrate that the best prompts optimized by OPRO outperform human-designed prompts...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 79 赞），本工作为突破 **AI4Science与记忆评测** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: FLM-101B: An Open LLM and How to Train It with $100K Budget
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」痛点，作者围绕 **FLM-101B** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we utilize a growth strategy to significantly reduce LLM training cost。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **101B parameters, 101B, 130B**。实验设计与验证细节：We introduce our benchmark including evaluations on important aspects of intelligence including symbolic mapping, itrule understanding, pattern mining, and...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We demonstrate that an LLM with 101B parameters and 0.31TB tokens can be trained on a 100K budget；Experimental results show that our model FLM-101B, trained with a budget of 100K, achieves comparable performance...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 45 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
